item.title: The agent in my pocket: how a side project survived a life with no free time
item.description: I have a toddler and a side-project Android app, and for a while I’d made my peace with the fact that only one of those was going to get built. Then I put Hermes Agent on my laptop and started talking to it through Telegram, and the app came back to life. (One day I got so into it I ran up 7,000 GitHub Copilot credits before I looked up — but that’s a footnote, not the point.)
